best_fixed_future_result.workload: 512 distinct candidates, prefix 100, four future ticks each; 2,048 actual ticks, final-only trace mode on both backends.
best_fixed_future_result.gpu_prototype: 31 scalarized call-free functions; original-function translation, dense arenas, isolated warps
best_fixed_future_result.timing_contract: One warmup pervariant/stride with fullselectedstatecompaction+continuationverification, then3 interleaved timedpairs eachstride. Every candidate/result/rankwire equals native on everyrun. Processwall includes setup/prefix/rollout/ranking/download; GPUevent phases storedseparately. Allcompilersidle, GPUexclusive. Small512x4 workload; no extrapolation to largecampaigns.
best_fixed_future_result.comparison_limit: Fixed futures/results/ranking match. GPU additionally compacts selected checkpoints; fixed-future CPU workers discard child states. Separate native resident matrix retains CPU checkpoint processes.
best_fixed_future_result.original_baseline_comparison_scope: Ratio against the preserved pre-followup median; this historical comparison was not freshly paired.

experiments.name: Explicit final device-link sm70
experiments.result: Exact parity; no useful speed gain.

experiments.name: Native function calls
experiments.result: Qualified optional translation of 386 original functions, bounded native calls, and invalid-PC/callback/budget safety; alone no search improvement.

experiments.name: Interleaved arenas
experiments.result: Native and full-state mapping gates pass. Packed 512x4 is 4.513x slower than matched isolated dense execution; remains optional.

experiments.name: Typed velocity solver
experiments.result: Full post-call semantics qualified; paired 512x4 gain of 1.232x over matched control.

experiments.name: General scalar leaves
experiments.result: 210 statically admitted; 31 dynamically selected and qualified. Best paired 512x4 gain is 1.241x, still 18.865x slower than CPU.

experiments.name: Full compiler optimization
experiments.result: Ofast0 frontend timed out at 300 seconds without an object or runtime result. Corrected mid frontend plus ptxasO3 has exact parity but is about 1.1 percent slower; not adopted.

experiments.name: Restricted Guest references
experiments.result: No useful host speed gain; not adopted.

experiments.name: Hardware PC profiling
experiments.result: Setup succeeds but actual sampling ends with insufficient privileges (35); zero PC records. No stall or hot-PC claims.

scalar_qualification.scope: Valid native-engine arenas and existing admitted numeric domain. Other 179 static admissions remain unqualified. Two repeated physics trajectories plus a mixed-game lifecycle gate; no exhaustive semantic proof.

native_resident_comparison.scope: Native exact prefix once; selected fork/COW states retained across depths; same Session-v4 results, lifecycle and selection as the supplied GPU capture. Python parity/hash work excluded from process wall timers. GPU not timed by this tool.
native_resident_comparison.verification_scope: Every saved final-only Result/rank/selected-child/lifecycle byte matches independent native resident execution. This adds every-leaf final-result qualification to the older winner-reset verification; not a new per-tick fulltrace campaign or scalar large-campaign timing.

why_stopped: Direct calls, arena layout and compiler changes did not produce major gains.
The 31 scalar leaves improve the fixed workload modestly; eligible dynamic leaves cover 24 to 28 percent of guest blocks in the fixtures.
Remaining function calls and escaped stack addresses need substantially broader verified compiler or physics work; high register pressure already limits the scalar path.
Observed results remain far from 5x faster; no theoretical impossibility proof is claimed.
